description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_TagTransform_Font, which transforms deprecated FONT tags into SPAN tags with inline CSS styles by converting attributes like color, face, and size into CSS styles. It is part of the HTMLPurifier library's tag transformation subsystem for sanitizing and fixing HTML markup.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_TagTransform_Font
classes.description: A class that transforms FONT tags into SPAN tags with CSS styling by converting attributes like color, face, and size into inline styles.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms a FONT tag token into a SPAN tag token, applying CSS styles for color, face, and size based on the original FONT tag's attributes.
